mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY parent_id ASC, sort_order ASC
SELECT * FROM sys_menu WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.parent_id ASC, m.sort_order ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu(parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, path, component, icon, perms, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{parentId}, #{menuName}, #{menuType}, #{path}, #{component}, #{icon}, #{perms}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_menu SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_menu WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted = 0
